title: reaction.completed
description: M15D § fires when an in-flight reaction finishes — all input moles consumed and outputs placed. Carries the reaction id, total moles reacted, cumulative ΔH (J), and the per-pixel or per-cell scope. Lets cfctl + telemetry distinguish 'fire spreading' (chain of `triggered` events) from 'reaction depleted'. Producer: cf-material reaction evaluator on the final tick of a multi-tick reaction. Additive-only per M4 DR-002.
